summary: The root نجو (njw) primarily means to escape or be safe. It can also describe swiftness, outstripping others, or, in a more crude sense, voiding excrement or breaking wind.
lane: 1 نَجَا ذ Alvum dejecit; (Msb, TA;) ventumve per anum emisit: (TA:) he voided his ordure; or broke wind. -b2- نَجَا , inf. n. نَجَآءٌ , He was quick, or swift, and outstripped. (S.) See an ex. of the inf. n., voce غولٌ . -b3- نَجَا He became safe, or secure; he escaped. (Msb, &c.)
